title: Heat of Vaporization
description: Essential Criteria: The correct calculation of the heat of vaporization using the formula L = T * ΔS.

title: Enthalpy of Water
description: Essential Criteria: The correct determination of the enthalpy of water using the relationship dH = TdS + Vdp.

title: Gibbs Free Energy
description: Essential Criteria: The accurate calculation of the Gibbs free energy for both water and steam.

title: Correct Units
description: Important Criteria: Proper use of units throughout the calculations, ensuring consistency and correctness.

title: Thermodynamic Relationships
description: Important Criteria: Appropriate application of thermodynamic relationships in deriving enthalpy and Gibbs free energy.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Common errors related to sign mistakes in calculations, particularly in thermodynamic equations.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Failure to include necessary factors or terms in the equations, leading to incorrect final answers.
